notes.gyro: IMU gyro rad/s, body frame (MJCF 'gyro' sensor)
notes.accelerometer: IMU accelerometer m/s^2 incl. gravity, body frame (MJCF 'accelerometer' sensor)
notes.joint_pos_rel: joint angle - home pose, actuator order
notes.prev_action_1: policy output of the previous step (zeros at entry)
notes.prev_action_2: policy output two steps ago (zeros at entry)
notes.motor_targets_rel: low-pass filtered motor targets sent last step - home pose (starts at the clip's first frame)
notes.phase: [t/T, cos(2 pi t/T), sin(2 pi t/T)], T = clip length (loop: cycle length, t/T wraps)
notes.ref_joint_pos_next_rel: clip joint angles at t + dt - home pose
notes.ref_joint_vel_next_scaled: clip joint velocities at t + dt x 0.05

action.formula: raw_target = clip_q(t + dt) + action_scale * action; target = lpf(raw_target); target = clip(target, prev_target -/+ max_vel * dt)
